description.value: The Bistro is a comfort-food diner in Langley Township serving hearty breakfast, lunch, and dinner alongside classic coffees and specialty drinks. Led by Head Chef Josh Rhodes, the kitchen emphasizes fresh, high-quality ingredients and offers custom catering for events of all sizes. Touring cyclists will find a sit-down meal with table reservations, delivery, and a broad menu including vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options.

address.value: 20280 97 Avenue, Unit #10, Langley Township, BC V1M 4B9
